title: Utillian 6 Dab Pen Vaporizer (taxes extra)
description:
UTILLIAN 6 DAB PEN

The Utillian 6 redefines wax vaporization, delivering exceptional flavor and performance with every draw. By blending innovative design with thoughtful german engineering, it ensures your material is heated evenly for smooth, consistent vapor.

The integrated ruby terp pearl, dynamic airflow, and high-quality glass components work in harmony to unlock the full potential of your wax—no harshness, no waste, just pure, flavorful clouds. With built-in wax storage to keep your materials fresh and ready, the Utillian 6 is perfect for on-the-go enthusiasts who refuse to compromise on quality.

Key Features:
Vortex Airflow
Ruby Terp Pearl
Bottom-Heated Glass Bucket Chamber
Seethrough Glass Mouthpiece
Extended Mouthpiece
Discreet Wax Storage Compartment
1500mAh Battery
4 Temperature Settings

Included in the Box:
Utillian 6 Dab Pen
Vortex Seals
Mouthpiece Seals
USB-C Cable
Ruby Terp Pearl
Dab Tool
Extended Mouthpiece
